text:
Lina: Heads-up: noticed a weird stacking issue on the clusters table when the confirm modal opens while the toast queue is non-empty. Toasts slide in and sit above the modal footer CTA on 1280px width. Screenshot attached.

Marco: Yikes. I think the modal backdrop z-index is lower than the toast stack. We used z tokens inconsistently across components. We have z-modal=700, z-toast=800, z-fab=820. Modal should probably be above toasts.

Evelyn: Agree on hierarchy. Typical pattern: z-modal > z-fab > z-toast so modals always capture focus. Also UX question: do we want to push toasts down when modal appears or keep them floating? Pushing avoids overlap with modal content but can be jarring.

Tariq: From an implementation perspective, pushing would require layout changes on the table container and could break virtualized lists. Floating with clear stacking and margin is easier. Suggest: set z-modal: 900, z-fab: 850, z-toast: 800 and ensure toasts never render inside the modal container.

DesignLintBot: a11y-scan: ghost-button-border-color fails contrast on dark surfaces (ratio 2.6:1). Focus ring must meet 3:1 for small icon buttons. Also flagged focus-trap: `modal-close` is reachable after `modal-confirm` in DOM order, causing tab to jump.

Lina: Good catch re: focus order. Our modal markup puts footer after header in DOM for historical reasons. We should change DOM order to header -> body -> footer while preserving visual layout. That will fix tab sequence.

Marco: On spacing tokens: current `spacing-dense` is ambiguous. Proposing two options: `spacing-condensed` (layout density) or `spacing-slim` (component-level compactness). Which do we prefer?

Evelyn: I vote `spacing-condensed` — clearer for layout scales. Also we need a small name map for migration: `spacing-dense` -> `spacing-condensed` and keep a deprecation alias for 2 releases.

Tariq: Also, button hit targets: some grouped icon buttons in the table row are 32x32. We must enforce 44x44 min while keeping visual 32px icons. Add invisible padding via hit-target token: `button-hit` = 44px.

Lina: Copy nit: confirm CTA currently says `Confirm`. For destructive actions we usually use `Delete` or `Remove`, and for destructive with secondary confirmation we use `Confirm delete`. For this modal it's a restart job flow so `Restart` is clearer than `Confirm`. Please update i18n keys.

Marco: I'll take the z-token + CSS changes. Plan: move modal z to 900, toasts to 800, ensure toasts mount at body root, add regression test for modal+toast overlap.

Evelyn: I'll update token names and add migration notes in tokens.md. Will include a Figma frame showing `spacing-condensed` vs `spacing-regular`.

Tariq: I'll add the hit target utility and adjust the table-row button component. Will add e2e test to assert 44px computed size.

Lina: Thanks. Quick snippet if helpful:``` /* ensure toasts don't sit over modals */ .toast-portal { position: fixed; right: 16px; bottom: 16px; z-index: var(--z-toast,800); } .modal { z-index: var(--z-modal,900); } ``` Also for focus order, keep footer after body in DOM and visually align with flex column.

DesignLintBot: NOTE: after proposed changes, re-run a11y-scan for keyboard focus order and color contrast.

Marco: No objections. I'll open PRs and tag owners: cc @Evelyn @Tariq.

Evelyn: Will add design signoff once tokens PR merges.

Tariq: I'll link the visual regression CI once ready.

Lina: Perfect 44d. I'll file the design ticket and attach the screenshots + Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/stacking-and-spacing-v2.
